wholePhysicalScope: The mapped outline fixes the 60 m by 55 m main hall and the attached eastern volume of approximately 57 m by 37 m. The hall proper is the large rectangle with the uninterrupted north glazing. The wing reaches the current public approach on the east.
lodDetails: The shelter footprint, rail-facing opening, shed roof, nameboard, bench and platform remain present at all levels. Close views add bench slats, sign lettering and fasteners.
limitations: The mapped roof envelope controls the exterior footprint. Curvature, folded profile, side doors and plant are based on the limited views and architectural records. The floor at the two linked volumes is an estimate.
Original DEM elevations provide the context. Local ground contact and the unpictured service façades are approximate.
